verdict.rationale: A probe confirms CodeRabbit publishes an OpenAPI spec at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, and a community comment references calling CodeRabbit's API to generate a patch, so a first-party API exists. Nothing in the pack documents what that API covers. Many UI surfaces (Triage queue actions, Change Stack review and merge, Dashboard metrics, settings) have no evidenced API equivalent, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint coverage, an explicit API/UI parity statement, API access to Triage/Change Stack/Dashboard/configuration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: calls CodeRabbit's API to generate a patch
